model.title: A resolution to authorize representation by the Senate Legal Counsel in Federal Trade Commission v. Key Investment Group, LLC, et al.

summary.text: The resolution would authorize the Senate Legal Counsel to represent the Senate in a Federal Trade Commission lawsuit against Key Investment Group, LLC and related parties.
